_comment: Queries + expected row counts for the three-graph lifesci browser demo (docs/fstar-extracted/demo-lifesci.html). Used by lifesci_parity.sh to assert native/js/wasm parity. Expected counts come from a live native run on the committed docs/fstar-extracted/lifesci/ TTL files (2026-04-23).

queries.name: 03-variant-chrom
queries.note: Cross-graph join with LIMIT 20. Previously stack-overflowed on js/wasm due to Hashtbl.find_all recursion in the #97 indexed store; fixed by switching to (key, triple list) single-binding shape.

queries.name: 04-top-diseases
queries.note: Entirely within disease graph; GROUP BY, LIMIT 10.

queries.name: 01-count-per-graph
queries.note: COUNT(*) GROUP BY ?g over three named graphs.

queries.name: 02-top-types
queries.note: UNION over P31 / rdf:type; LIMIT 10 but only 3 distinct types present in this subset. Previously stack-overflowed; same Hashtbl.find_all fix.

queries.name: 05-disease-gene-crossgraph
queries.note: Cross-graph BGP; returns 0 rows on this subset because the two predicates don't co-occur for any shared entity. Included to confirm zero-result handling is consistent across engines.
